description: Factorial transfer of teacher-free formed protocols into finite-generation social learning
research_question: Does the topology that forms a grounded protocol determine how well that protocol survives newcomer replacement, and does the transmission topology interact with the formation topology?
formal_matrix: 4 seeds × 3 panels × 3 formation endpoints × 3 transmission schedules = 108 chains
limits: The formation endpoints inherit frozen private visual encoders from earlier perceptual training.
The transfer phase tests four replacement events and does not model demographic selection or autonomous partner choice.
The task has two resources and one token from each complementary sender; it does not test natural-language grammar.
Formation and transmission conditions are experimenter-specified topology schedules, not human social history.
